summary: Tested new features from review request (team CMS, editable hero facility overlay, editable Contact hours, gallery marquee with video support, video uploads, Concierge mounted). Backend: 39/39 pytest tests pass including all new endpoints (/api/team, /admin/cms/team CRUD, PUT /api/admin/content for hero.facility_* + contact.hours keys, /admin/cms/gallery video items, POST /api/admin/upload accepts video/mp4 and rejects text/plain). Frontend: homepage renders hero facility image on desktop AND mobile (390px viewport confirmed), Team section with member card, Gallery marquee + View gallery button + grid + lightbox (close/prev/next), Contact Hours card, Concierge widget mounted (camille-launcher/panel/input/send) with working POST /api/chat. Admin > Site editor tab renders all editors including HERO FACILITY IMAGE URL, FACILITY SIGNATURE/TITLE/SUBTITLE, Team, Gallery, Hours.

ui_bugs.issue: The lightbox <Media> element does NOT have a data-testid="lightbox-image" attribute. Review request explicitly listed lightbox-image among required testids. lightbox-close/prev/next are present and working. Fix: add data-testid="lightbox-image" to the <Media> inside the lightbox Dialog (Gallery.jsx ~line 198-203).

integration_issues.issue: The lead form (lead-name/phone/interest/submit) is conditionally rendered only after the user sends >=2 chat messages (Concierge.jsx line 51: `if (userCount >= 2 && !leadShown && !leadSent) setLeadShown(true);`). Not a bug — expected UX — but automated testers/QA should send 2 chat messages before asserting the form is visible. Confirmed the form testids exist in code and render when triggered.

issues: A yellow promo banner 'TEST_Offer — d' still appears at top of every page (seeded during iteration_1 testing). Should be deleted from /api/admin/offers before shipping to user.

action_items: Add data-testid='lightbox-image' to the <Media> element inside the lightbox Dialog in /app/frontend/src/components/sections/Gallery.jsx (~line 198).
Delete leftover TEST_Offer seed data via admin CMS (or via DELETE /api/admin/offers/{id}) so the public homepage no longer shows a stray yellow promo banner.

(Optional UX) Consider surfacing the lead form immediately when the user opens the Concierge (or offer a 'Request a callback' button) instead of gating it behind 2 chat turns; otherwise QA/users may believe the lead form is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1759 lines — split into routers (auth/admin/cms/payments/chat/content) for maintainability.
POST /api/admin/upload correctly gates by content_type against ALLOWED_UPLOAD_MIME (image+video); rejection message now lists allowed types (verified).

GET /api/hero-images falls back to brand.hero_facility_image_url content key before DEFAULT_HERO_IMAGES — good, but this coupling should be documented so admins know clearing hero_images collection but setting the facility URL still yields images.

Gallery.jsx grid buttons inside the 'View gallery' dialog have no data-testid on the buttons themselves — only marquee items do (gallery-item-{i}). Consider adding gallery-grid-item-{i} for E2E test coverage of the grid → lightbox path.
Concierge lead form is gated by userCount>=2 which is undiscoverable for testers — either lower the threshold or expose an explicit 'Get in touch' button that sets leadShown=true.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all sections render, all critical testids resolve except lightbox-image; TEST_ promo banner still visible)
